text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen"... A 1,200m 
sprint race, huh. The distance where my 
current strengths shine the brightest...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, will this "Takamatsunomiya Kinen" 
be my last domestic race, I wonder?

"The Prix Jacques Le Marois is held in 
mid-August. We could run the Yasuda Kinen 
in early June before that, but..."

I want to have plenty of time before the 
overseas campaign. For now, the plan was 
to head straight there from here.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay. If I'll be parting ways with my 
domestic followers for a while, then—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now more than ever, I cannot afford to run 
a half-hearted race.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now then, I wonder who today's rivals will 
be, sending me off to race overseas?
"Your opponent is meee! Touuuhhh!!!!"

"The one who appeared from above was the 
hero-admiring Umamusume, Biko Pegasus."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely taking 1st place today and 
becoming a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Now, bring it on, Pearl-senpai! I won't 
let you take this world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry, but the world is mine for the 
taking. After all, that's what I run for.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Though, I don't take it to make the world 
suffer. I merely wish to bring joy to the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Bring joy to... the world?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So Pearl-senpai, you want to become a 
world hero?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: A hero, huh?
Seeking the Pearl thought for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Not quite. I'm no hero. Who I truly am is—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"You'll understand if we run together 
today♪ Bring it on."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's gooo!

Seeking the Pearl plays along with Biko 
Pegasus's hero game. Unlike superhero 
shows, you never know who will win a real 
race.
